scripts.dev:services: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names "ui,api,gateway" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:raw --workspace=packages/api" "npm run dev:raw --workspace=packages/gateway"

scripts.check:syntax: node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node --check scripts/site-stage.mjs && node --check scripts/build-schema.mjs && node --check scripts/check-ui-theme-contrast.mjs && node --check scripts/check-ui-i18n-parity.mjs && node --check scripts/check-ui-i18n-composition-mode.mjs && node --check scripts/check-docs-manual-sidebar.mjs && node --check scripts/check-docs-i18n.mjs && node --check scripts/check-db-ready.mjs && node --check scripts/check-release-readiness.mjs && node --check scripts/check-repo-legacy-residue.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/postgres-migration-utils.mjs && node --check scripts/db-schema-apply.mjs && node --check scripts/db-schema-status.mjs && node --check scripts/docker-image-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/check-ui-lazy-validation.mjs && node --check scripts/check-core-headless.mjs
scripts.build:verify: npm run build:ui && npm run build:api && npm run build:gateway && npm run check:ui:bundle-budget && npm run check:syntax
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:gateway && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:core
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:ui:store-boundaries && npm run check:ui:lazy-validation && npm run check:core:headless && npm run check:ui:theme-contrast && npm run check:ui:i18n-parity && npm run check:ui:i18n-composition-mode && npm run check:docs:manual-sidebar && npm run check:docs:i18n && npm run check:repo:legacy-residue && npm run check:ts:debt && npm run check:ts:source-artifacts && npm run check:runtime-deps && npm run check:db:ready && npm run test && npm run build:verify && npm run typecheck
scripts.clean:deps: rimraf node_modules packages/ui/node_modules packages/api/node_modules packages/gateway/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules packages/core/node_modules
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:deps
scripts.docs:generate: npm run docs:generate:api && npm run docs:generate:graphql && npm run docs:generate:vue
scripts.docs:verify: npm run docs:generate && npm run site:stage
scripts.demo:build:local: cross-env FREEBOARD_STATIC=1 FREEBOARD_BASE_PATH=/demo/ npm run build --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.demo:build:pages: cross-env FREEBOARD_STATIC=1 FREEBOARD_BASE_PATH=/freeboard/demo/ npm run build --workspace=packages/ui

scripts.site:local: npm run docs:generate && npm run site:stage && npm run demo:build:local && npm run site:build:local && npm run site:copy-demo
scripts.site:pages: npm run docs:generate && npm run site:stage && npm run demo:build:pages && npm run site:build:pages && npm run site:copy-demo
